about: The pinyin WITH tone marks the pin games show for hsk1 (his rule 2026-10-24), keyed by the pack's own plain text: words by «pinyin|meaning», lines and written questions by their exact text, items = a tile that reads differently in one question. Copied from the books (La Base content/audios/hsk1-base.json first, then the vocabulary modules roblox/shared*/…Vocab.lua, then the golden book content/golden/), letter by letter onto the pack's spelling; where they differ or are silent, a word's neighbours in the books decide, and anything decided by meaning is listed in the hand-back's tones check (2026-10-24). A new pack line needs its entry here: scripts/test-pack-tones.js says which.
